qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the KI. D+ wire to alternator for M10/M20 engines?
What torque should be applied to all other KI. D+ wires to alternator besides M10/M20?
What is the torque specification for the KI. B+ wire S38 B 38 connection?
How much torque should be applied to all other KI. B+ connections?
What is the torque specification for the alternator pulley?
What torque should be applied to the pulley for the ribbed drive belt?
What is the torque specification for the alternator rear holder?
How much torque should be applied to the fillister head screw for the wire holder?
What is the torque specification for the alternator on bearing block?
Which alternator components have the same torque specification of 3.5 Nm?
qa_pairs.answer: The rear holder and fillister head screw for wire holder both require 3.5 Nm (ft. lbs.)
